sloka: आसीनस्त्वेव भरत: पौरजानपदं जनम् ।उवाच सर्वत: प्रेक्ष्य किमार्यं नानुशासथ ॥ २.१११.१९॥
transliteration: āsīnastveva bharata: paurajānapadaṁ janam ।uvāca sarvata: prekṣya kimāryaṁ nānuśāsatha ॥ 2.111.19॥

translations.english: While remaining seated, Bharata looking all around at the inhabitants from towns and villages, questioned them 'why don't you all persuade my esteemed brother to return'.
